message.reasoning_content: "Old Brown Shoe" B-side of "The Ballad of John and Yoko," released June 1969. Recorded April 1969. Not June option... May 1969? The single released 30 May 1969 in UK? Actually "The Ballad of John and Yoko" was released 30 May 1969 in UK, 4 June US. So May 1969.
